title.zh: 比特币财库公司Strive签约七家机构，拟通过ATM发行至多10亿美元优先股
title.en: 比特币财库公司Strive签约七家机构，拟通过ATM发行至多10亿美元优先股

current_state.zh: Bitcoin treasury company Strive signed sales agreements with seven broker-dealers including Cantor Fitzgerald, Barclays and Clear Street to sell up to $1 billion of 15% Series A perpetual preferred stock (ticker SATS) via an at-the-market offering, with agent commissions of up to 2% and issuance timing dependent on market conditions.
current_state.en: Bitcoin treasury company Strive signed sales agreements with seven broker-dealers including Cantor Fitzgerald, Barclays and Clear Street to sell up to $1 billion of 15% Series A perpetual preferred stock (ticker SATS) via an at-the-market offering, with agent commissions of up to 2% and issuance timing dependent on market conditions.
